title: Claude Code from zero
subtitle: Track 1 · {modules} modules · {lessons} lessons · for managers and developers · no sign-up

practice.heading: Practice checked in your terminal
practice.body: Every module ends with a task you solve in Claude Code. A local script checks the result, no account, no upload.

projects.heading: Built with Claude Code by a salesperson, not a programmer
projects.body: Camerata, Kinly, Fabulita and vdmitriev.com are real products the author shipped this way. The course shows that path, not theory.

sources.heading: Honest sources
sources.body: Lessons are adapted from MIT-licensed repositories. Each lesson names its source, authors and commit, and quotes the official Claude Code docs with a link.

contact.heading: Need this in your company?
contact.body: Write to the author: email or Telegram. No forms, no tracking.
